headline: 10-mo PH dollar deficit breaks past ’26 ceiling
summary: The Philippines' dollar shortfall in the first 10 months of 2026 has exceeded the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas' year-end estimate. High oil prices inflated imports and foreign fund outflows added pressure.
why: The balance of payments tracks cross-border money flows, and persistent deficits can weigh on the peso and sovereign risk. The central bank sets the monetary policy framework for the country.
